title: Update and add tests in `crates/ui/aura-ui-terminal` after a layout change to the TASKS side tab. The production code i…
summary: I fixed all 20 failing tests in `crates/ui/aura-ui-terminal` and added the new ones; the last run of `cargo test -p aura-ui-terminal --lib -- tasks side_scope` passed 44 of 44. I didn't change any production code. Out of time, I didn't run the crate's full test suite, and the filtered tests weren't re-run after the final `cargo fmt -p aura-ui-terminal`.
